red_tests.failure_fingerprint: ACCESSIBILITY_GAUGE_VALUE_TEXTUAL_SCORE_MISSING or ACCESSIBILITY_FOCUS_VISIBLE_CSS_MISSING or RECOVERY_RETRY_BUTTON_MISSING or RECOVERY_RETRY_READING_FUNCTION_MISSING or RECOVERY_ERROR_HANDLER_UNHIDE_RETRY_MISSING or ACCESSIBILITY_HITL_ALERT_ROLE_ALERT_MISSING or RECOVERY_RETRY_DROPS_PAYLOAD or ACCESSIBILITY_KEYBOARD_ENTER_MISSING or ACCESSIBILITY_UNKNOWN_HOUR_ROLE_NOTE_MISSING

rationale: Record verified test provenance baseline for Horo Lite Phase I (TICKET-HLITE-009 / TICKET-HLITE-009-QA) Accessibility, Privacy, Error Recovery & Unknown-Time Ergonomics contract verification in tests/test_horo_lite_unified_reading.py: 1) Score indicators include text alternatives (never color alone): .score-gauge has role='img' and aria-label matching label/score; .gauge-value node contains textual score; .score-gauge-range has role='img' and aria-label containing score range. 2) Keyboard navigation and visible focus: lite.css defines :focus and :focus-visible rules with visible outline (3px solid var(--focus-ring)); attachExportButtonKeyboardSupport binds Enter and Space keys to button.click(). 3) ARIA roles and landmarks: #status-message has role='status' and container aria-live='polite'; #feedback-emphasis-indicator has role='status' and aria-live='polite'; #hitl-alert has role='alert'; unknown-hour notice has role='note'; chip rows and consent controls have role='group'. 4) Resilient error recovery: #result-retry button exists with aria-label; retryReading() triggers retry via submitButton.click() without dropping state.lastPayload; submitReading error handler unhides retry button on failure. 5) Unknown birth-time ergonomics: renderUnknownHourNotice handles uncertain_birth_time; syncUnknownHour cleanly disables birth_time without resetting form. Negative control matrix verifies fail-closed assertions on missing gauge text score alternatives, missing focus/focus-visible styles, missing retry button or recovery logic, missing role='alert' on hitlAlert, dropping state.lastPayload, missing keyboard navigation, and missing role='note'. Full test suite verification: 19/19 PASS (100% pass rate), zero regressions.
